properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): the report's "no bundle form through the connector" is PARTLY OVERTURNED. create_edges was offered through flo2's door on 0.74.0 and covers the thin structural edges, about 75 of the ~270 single-edge calls. But none of the typed helpers names its bulk form, and the helpers with semantics (constrains, governed_by, authored_by, ~100 calls) have no stated bulk route
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), triage of art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29, item I24, 2026-09-29.

① OBSERVED (designer, friction-log entry #6): "Every typed edge is its own call through the connector, with no batch form." Counted: contain_component 18, allocate ~20, provides/consumes ~37, set_interface_spec 12, constrains ~50, governed_by ~30, authored_by ~18, review_relations 7. About 190 single-edge calls in round 1 and about 270 over 3 rounds. Expected: a bundle write.

② PRECEDENT:
- cap:bulk-forms ("one call where the surface measured N"), pinned by ver:bulk-forms.
- dec:idea-verifies-takes-a-list-of-targets.
- req:the-mcp-surface-is-sized-for-tokens-per-task (c) BUNDLES, proposed 2026-09-28.

③ CANDIDATES:
(a) No bulk form exists.
(b) One exists and the connector does not offer it.
(c) One is offered and nothing on the path names it.
(d) A bulk form cannot carry the helpers' semantics.
(e) The observation is wrong.

④⑤ MEASURED:
- flo2's generated catalog (services/edge-gateway/src/engine-tools.ts, from 0.74.0) OFFERS create_edges and create_nodes, so (a) and (b) are refuted.
- create_edges' own description reads "the bulk form of create_edge, and so of every typed helper built on it: contains, contain_component, satisfies, allocate, realizes". It is all-or-nothing, with check_only.
- provides and consumes are the same thin shape as allocate (capture.rs ~2437/~2455: one g.provides / g.consumes and an EdgeDto). So contain_component, allocate, provides and consumes (~75 calls) had a bulk route.
- In the 0.74.0 tools/list, NONE of allocate, provides, consumes, constrains, governed_by, authored_by or contain_component mentions create_edges or "bulk".
- flo2's COMMON_DESIGN_TOOLS names 13 tools and no bulk form.
So (c) is confirmed.
- constrains goes through constrains_in, with unit, basis, source and measured_at. governed_by carries `ruling`. authored_by runs the role-set normaliser. create_edges takes free `props` and names none of them, so (d) holds for ~100 of the calls: no bulk route is STATED for them. Whether create_edges would apply their checks was not established.

⑥ CLASS. The bulk form is discoverable only from its own description, which the caller reads only if it already knows to look. And "built on create_edge" is a hand-kept list of 5 in prose. Would naming it have prevented this? For ~75 calls, yes. The remaining ~100 need bulk forms that keep each helper's semantics, which is (c) BUNDLES.

⑦⑧ OWED:
- A test that every typed edge helper built on create_edge names its bulk form (or the served description is generated from one list).
- A statement, for each semantic helper, of whether create_edges applies its checks.
- The fixes.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED:
- Whether create_edges validates CONSTRAINS contribution and unit or the governed_by ruling (not reproduced).
- The designer's per-tool counts are its own estimates.

CLOSED 2026-09-29: fixed by reflow2 PR #629 (squash 083790e). Its change record, chg:a-bulk-edge-write-runs-each-typed-helpers-own-checks, and its passing check, ver:a-bulk-edge-write-keeps-each-helpers-checks, are in main's committed export, not in this live store.

Verified on origin/main: crates/reflow2-mcp/src/bulk_edges.rs adds `draw_edges`. Each item names a typed helper and carries that helper's own arguments, and it runs the helper's shared body, so constrains' contribution/unit/source, governed_by's ruling and authored_by's role normaliser all apply. The batch is all-or-nothing, failures are named by position, and a check-only mode writes nothing. Every typed helper's served description names it; this is appended at serve time, so find_tools ranking is unaffected.

Both owed items are delivered. First, tests/a_bulk_edge_write_keeps_each_helpers_checks.rs drives the same inputs through each single helper and through draw_edges, enumerated from the served surface. Second, it thereby states for every semantic helper that the bulk form applies its checks.

Measured in #629: the designer's roughly 270 single-edge calls over three rounds come to about 3–4 draw_edges calls.

Not built: structure bundles (a component written with its edges in one call), option (d) of the idea.

Found on the way and recorded separately: governed_by accepts a parks ruling on a PROPOSED decision (fact:governed-by-accepts-a-parks-ruling-on-a-proposed-decision-and-nothing-says-it-parks-nothing-2026-09-29).

This live server still runs 0.74.0 and has not been seen serving it.
